headline: Global reset announced for all paid ChatGPT accounts
sourceTimezone: PST (UTC−8, as written); may mean local PDT (UTC−7)
scope: All paid ChatGPT accounts, as stated by Tibo.

announcement.text: Global reset landing tomorrow 10am PST for all paid ChatGPT accounts. Apologies for the slow start with GPT-6.1 Sol, it's now back to running at expected speeds after the massive load spike in the first two days.
announcement.translation: 所有付费 ChatGPT 账号将于明天 PST 上午 10 点迎来全局重置。抱歉 GPT-6.1 Sol 起初运行较慢；在前两天的负载激增后，现在已恢复到预期速度。

note: The post was published on October 1 at 19:14:51 PDT, so tomorrow means October 2 in the Pacific context. The target follows literal PST: October 2 at 18:00 UTC (October 3 at 02:00 in UTC+8). If PST means local PDT, the target is one hour earlier: 17:00 UTC (01:00 in UTC+8). This is an announcement, not evidence that the reset has happened. The post does not specify banked-reset behavior or which usage windows will reset. The speed-recovery statement is attributed to Tibo.
